a.text: Honest concern before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan (operate until the reserve hits 8) means we both almost certainly end round 1 with empty units. The reserve only has 4 now, so only one of us can be safe right away. I'd like to revisit the plan openly rather than have either of us quietly break it. What are you planning for round 1? I'll tell you my real action before I act.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Understood. I'll stick to our agreement and operate. Once the reserve reaches 8, we take 4 each and nothing more.
Operating again. That should bring the reserve to 8. Next round we each take exactly 4, as agreed.

b.text: Once the reserve shows 8 I will take my share.
